# Items

Items are the things on a list: "Eggs × 12", "Sourdough loaf × 1".

## Adding an item

Open a list, type the item under **Item**, set the **Quantity** and press
**Add item**. The quantity starts at 1 and can be anything from 1 to 999.
Item names can be up to 80 characters long.

New items go to the bottom of the list.

## Marking an item bought

Press **Mark bought** next to an item when it's in your basket. The item is
crossed out and stays on the list, and the count at the top ("5 to buy")
goes down by one.

Changed your mind? Press **Mark not bought** and it's back on the to-buy
count.

## Deleting an item

Press **Delete** next to an item to take it off the list altogether.

## The to-buy count

The number beside a list's name — on the list itself and on **Your lists** —
is how many items are still to buy. Bought items don't count. When it reaches
**0 to buy**, everything on the list is in the basket.

## Who can change items

The owner of a list and everyone it's shared with can add items, mark them
bought or not bought, and delete them. Everyone sees the same list, so if
someone else ticks off the milk, it's ticked off for you too. Reload the page
to see their latest changes.
